comments.text_zh: 在你花三个小时看这些讲座之前，你应该知道这个标题极具误导性。这些讲座根本不是关于 QM 的，而是关于 QM 的历史，尽管讲述者确实是亲历者之一。但亲耳听 QM 历史的那种酷劲，被一个事实削弱了：Bethe 显然早已过了巅峰期，而且他并不特别擅长讲故事。如果你想要一个名副其实的视频，我推荐这个：[链接] 编辑：如果你想真正理解 QM，还有这个：[视频] :-)
comments.text: Before you invest three hours to watch these lectures you should know that the title is terribly misleading. These lectures are not about QM at all, they are about the history of QM, albeit told by someone who was actually part of it. But the coolness of hearing the history of QM firsthand is undermined by the fact that Bethe is clearly well past his prime, and he's not particularly good at telling stories. If you want a video that is true to this title I'd recommend this: [LINK] EDIT: And if you want to really understand QM, there's this: [VIDEO] :-)

comments.author: cromwellian

comments.text_zh: 这场 Google Talk [视频] 以清晰易懂的方式运用纠缠和量子信息理论，解释“幽灵般的”量子现象，比如量子擦除器、退相干、Aspect 实验和测量问题。即使你完全不懂 QM，只懂基础代数和微积分，它也非常容易入门。我以前是多世界诠释的粉丝，但看完这个之后，我现在非常支持量子信息理论的解释。大约从 43 分钟开始，他进入 QM 信息理论的解释，但我建议看完整场演示。我最初关于这个主题的帖子链接：[链接]
comments.text: This Google Talk [VIDEO] uses entanglement and quantum information theory in a clear and understandable way to explain 'spooky' quantum phenomena, like the quantum eraser, de-coherence, the aspect experiment, and the measurement problem. Even if you don't know any QM, just basic algebra and calculus, it's really approachable. I used to be a fan of the Many Worlds interpretation, but after seeing this, I'm now a big fan of the Quantum Information Theory explanation. Starting about 43 minutes in, he goes into the QM Information Theory explanation, but I'd recommend watching the entire prezo. Link to my original post on the subject: [LINK]

comments.author: replax
comments.story_title: A Schrödinger cat with eight lives: quantum entanglement of eight photons
comments.why_zh: Ron Garret 反驳哥本哈根诠释的演讲
comments.quote_zh: 观看他关于此事的 Google Talk
comments.text_zh: 事实上，同为 Lisp 程序员的 Ron Garret 已经证明哥本哈根诠释是错的。你可以在这里读他的论文：www.flownet.com/ron/QM.pdf，并观看他关于此事的 Google Talk [视频]。问题在于，大多数人（注意，不是科学家）反正并不真的在乎，而哥本哈根诠释给了你一个很适合讲的好故事，它相当“奇怪”，却又多少能理解。我讨厌的是，连科学杂志都仍然 100% 信奉哥本哈根诠释，只是为了吸引更多读者、好使用更抓人的标题。
comments.text: In fact, the Copenhagen interpretation has been proven wrong by fellow lisper Ron Garret. You can read his paper here: www.flownet.com/ron/QM.pdf and watch his google talk about it [VIDEO] . The problem is, that most people (not scientists, mind you) do not really care anyway, and the Copenhagen interpretation gives you a nice story to tell, which is fairly "strange", yet somewhat understandable. I hate the fact that even science magazines still 100% subscribe to the Copenhagen interpretation, just to attract a greater readership and to be able to use catchier headlines.

comments.author: newpavlov
comments.story_title: Computer scientists prove that heat destroys quantum entanglement
comments.why_zh: 超决定论的不错入门
comments.quote_zh: 这段视频可以是这个主题的一个不错的入门
comments.text_zh: 关于贝尔不等式，有一个非常重要却常被遗忘的前提：它涵盖的是局域隐变量。如果我们假设测量装置和粒子产生装置彼此纠缠（毕竟从大爆炸以来它们有太多机会纠缠了），那么我们就有一个全局隐变量，而量子测量的随机性就只是把全局状态从图景中抹去后产生的简单副产品。这种量子力学诠释通常被称为「超决定论」，就个人而言，我比那套塌缩波函数的黑色巫毒测量魔法、或每次微小测量就创造全新世界的说法喜欢它得多。这段视频可以是这个主题的一个不错的入门：[VIDEO]（别在意标题党标题，视频本身很好）
comments.text: There is a very important and often forgotten caveat to the Bell's inequalities: it covers local hidden states. If we are to assume that measurement and particle creation apparatuses are entangled with each other (after all, they had plenty of opportunities since the big bang), then we have a global hidden state and the quantum measurment randomness becomes a simple artifact of removing global state from the picture. This interpretation of QM is usually called "superdeterminism" and, personally, I like it much more than the black vodoo measurement magic with collapsing wave functions or creation of whole new worlds on each tiny measurement. This video can be a good introduction to this topic: [VIDEO] (don't mind the clickbaity title, the video itself is good)

comments.author: themgt
comments.story_title: Interpretations of quantum theory: A map of madness
comments.why_zh: Garret“零世界诠释”的出处
comments.quote_zh: 正如 Ron Garret 所造的“零世界诠释”[1]
comments.text_zh: Mermin 的说法也许最简洁：现实是“没有相关项的相关性”（correlations without correlata）；或者用 Ron Garret 造的说法，是“零世界诠释”[1]。从社会学层面我也觉得说得通：这种诠释似乎动摇了西方科学思想的根基，正因为如此它才长期被极力回避，很多人宁愿相信一个无限分叉（但不知怎么仍算“真实”）的多宇宙，也不愿接受现实本身是主体间的这一想法。[1] [视频]
comments.text: Mermin put it perhaps most succinctly, that reality is "correlations without correlata", or as Ron Garret coined, the "zero-worlds interpretation"[1] It also makes sense to me on a sociological level, that the way in which this interpretation seems to undermine the very foundation of western, scientific thought is the reason it has been so desperately avoided for so long, with many preferring to believe in an infinite forking (but somehow still "real) multiverse, than the idea that reality itself is intersubjective. [1] [VIDEO]
